description: This file defines and manages plugin interactive handlers, including registration, clearing, and dispatching logic, with support for deduplication and namespace validation.

classes.name: RegisteredInteractiveHandler
classes.description: Type combining PluginInteractiveHandlerRegistration with plugin identification details.

classes.name: InteractiveRegistrationResult
classes.description: Result type indicating success or failure of registration, with error message if any.

classes.name: InteractiveDispatchResult
classes.description: Union type representing possible dispatch outcomes: matched, handled, and duplicate status.

classes.name: PluginInteractiveMatch
classes.description: Type representing a matched plugin interaction, including registration info, namespace, and payload.

classes.name: InteractiveState
classes.description: Internal state holding registered handlers and deduplication cache.

methods.name: toRegistryKey
methods.description: Creates a normalized key for handler registration based on channel and namespace.

methods.name: validateNamespace
methods.description: Validates namespace string for allowed characters and non-emptiness.

methods.name: resolveNamespaceMatch
methods.description: Finds a registered handler matching the channel and data namespace.
